facts.value: The Department of Economics offers a double bachelor's program together with the long-term partner university Paris Dauphine-PSL, which is supported by the Franco-German University (DFH). Students who successfully complete a year of study in Paris will receive both the bachelor's degree from the Department of Economics at Goethe University and the bachelor's degree certificate from Université Paris Dauphine-PSL.
